mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS are both above 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) during manufacturing expansion cycles drives corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer spending, which is a leading indicator of corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above 3-month average and UNRATE is below 3.7%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market booms (HOUST > 1300 thousand units) during expansionary cycles boost related sectors and consumer confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1300.
